title: 50-Foot Vegetable Theater
description: Something has gone horribly wrong in Dr. Fiend’s laboratory, and the vegetables are growing out of control. A movie that examines the consequences of scientists meddling in things they don’t understand.
quote: They said I was mad! But now I, and I alone, have given life to a squash!
altHero: Dr. Fiend, Igor, and a giant squash with arms and a mouth
alt3: Dr. Fiend and Igor next to a table with a blue blanket over something on a table
alt4: Dr. Fiend and Igor with a giant mushroom
